LanguageData.CS_Quest_AtiumCaravan_Ambush_Tip: Strike the wagons on the open road. The escort carry the atium on their persons, a bead apiece, so nothing is yours until they are down. The Ministry will not forget who struck first.
LanguageData.CS_Quest_AtiumCaravan_Bribe_Tip: Offer the captain silver to look away. He brings the atium to you himself and the wagons roll on. Quieter than steel, and the Ministry need never know.
LanguageData.CS_Quest_AtiumCaravan_Stage_Choice: Decide how the wagons will be taken.
LanguageData.CS_Quest_AtiumCaravan_Stage_Travel: Reach the transfer road before the convoy passes.
LanguageData.CS_Quest_AtiumCaravan_Stage_Clear: Put down the escort, then search them. Each carries a bead. Obligators do not surrender wagons.
LanguageData.CS_Quest_Hathsin_Stage_Travel: Follow the survivor's map to the Pits, past where the obligators cared to dig. Ministry soldiers hold the seam. Take it from them.
LanguageData.CS_Quest_Pits_Stage_Travel: Reach the Pits of Hathsin. Not the seam this time - the farm itself, and the garrison the Lord Ruler keeps on it.
LanguageData.CS_Quest_Pits_Stage_Carry: Work the basin out. Leave the last scraps if you like - what matters is that the crop is gone. Come and go as you need; what you take does not grow back, and the Ministry will keep sending men while the ground is still worth holding.
LanguageData.CS_Quest_Inquisitor_Stage_Travel: Find the waypoint the Inquisitor has taken for itself, before it finishes working outward to you.
LanguageData.CS_Quest_Inquisitor_Stage_Clear: Put it down. Spikes through the eyes, and it still will not stop while it can stand.
LanguageData.CS_Quest_Hathsin_Stage_Carry: Cut the seam out. Roughly one cut in ten frees a bead. Work it until there is nothing left worth a pick.
LanguageData.CS_Quest_Reward_Connection: The colony drawn closer to Preservation
LanguageData.CS_Quest_Reward_Awakened: The Pits woke something. {COUNT} of the crew burn metal now who did not before.
